_comment: Held-out evidence documents for EvidenceFixtureTest: one short synthetic document per document type the
expansion lexicon names and the seeded demo corpus lacks. They are never seeded into the demo; the test
ingests them through the real path inside a transaction that rolls back. Each is written the way the
real document reads (a payslip's fields, a court order's operative words), not toward the probe that
must find it. `seeded` maps the types the demo corpus already holds to a title substring of that document.
